text: Automatically embeds and indexes stored text without a separate embedding pipeline
quote: Chroma will store your text and handle embedding and indexing automatically.

text: Lets you swap in different embedding models (OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face, sentence-transformers, etc.)
quote: Use any embedding model. OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face, sentence-transformers, and more.

text: Query a collection with text queries and get back the n most similar results
quote: You can query the collection with a list of query texts, and Chroma will return the n most similar results.

text: Supports full-text search via $contains/$not_contains and regex pattern matching via $regex/$not_regex
quote: We support full-text search with the `$contains` and `$not_contains` operators. We also support regular expression pattern matching with the `$regex` and `$not_regex` operators.

text: get/query support combining document content search (where_document) with metadata filters
quote: `.get` and `.query` can handle `where_document` search combined with metadata filtering

text: Official CLI runs a local server, installs sample apps, browses collections, and manages Chroma Cloud DBs
quote: The Chroma CLI lets you run a Chroma server locally on your machine, install sample apps, browse your collections, interact with your Chroma Cloud DBs, and much more!

text: Offers sparse vector / lexical search using BM25 and SPLADE alongside dense vector search
quote: Sparse vector search - Lexical search (BM25, SPLADE)

text: Supports collection forking for dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll-outs
quote:
Forking

Dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll-outs

text: Forks are copy-on-write, only charging for incremental storage written after the fork
quote: Forking a collection costs $0.03 per fork request. Forks are copy-on-write. You only pay for incremental storage written after the fork; unchanged data remains shared.

text: Open source under Apache 2.0 license
quote: Chroma is licensed under Apache 2.0. Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.

text: Can run locally, self-host, or use a managed serverless Chroma Cloud offering
quote: Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.

text: Offers BYOC (bring your own cloud) for single-tenant deployments
quote: We offer a BYOC (bring your own cloud) option for single-tenant deployments.

text: Can index and search images, audio, and other modalities alongside text
quote: Index and search images, audio, and other modalities alongside text.

text: Provides ready-made agent setup prompts so tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex can configure Chroma automatically
quote: Give the following prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your favorite AI agent. It will quickly set you up with Chroma.

text: MCP server lets Claude directly use Chroma's search capabilities via a standardized protocol
quote: The Chroma MCP server allows Claude to directly interact with Chroma’s search capabilities through this standardized protocol.

text: MCP integration enables persistent memory across conversations
quote: The Chroma MCP server allows Claude to directly interact with Chroma's search capabilities through this standardized protocol. This enables powerful features like: Persistent memory across conversations

text: First-class integration with LangChain for building RAG applications
quote: LangChain + Chroma on the LangChain blog

quote: BYOC in your VPC, multi-cloud/multi-region replication, point-in-time-recovery ensure a resilient and scalable search system with the same 0-ops story as Cloud.

text: Point-in-time recovery is supported as part of the resilient BYOC/Cloud architecture
